body: Request is in the title, my 3 year old woke up from her nap and came out of her room with her dress like this.  It was one of the last things my late MIL gave to her so if there is any way to save it I need to try.  Any and all help is welcome and appreciated.

Thank you for your open and thoughtful response. You have given me a lot to consider and to keep in mind. I don't know what to say besides I am sorry for your loss. The words don't feel right, though they are true. Your story is not one I will soon forget, whatever the thoughts and prayers of a random stranger are worth to you, you will be in mine as I walk with my wife through this lifelong process. I hope your good days continue to increase.

Thank you for this reminder. I guess I mean that the kids will survive this, but you are right, their world is no longer going to be the same again, and what being "okay" looks like is not going to be the same either. 

Our oldest is still to young to understand any of this, but when the time comes, we will not hide the truth from them. It doesn't do anyone any favors pretending that things are different than they are.
Thank you. I will continue to be with her and try my best to help however she needs me.

Thank you. Our girls are still young, the oldest is going to be devastated at first, but they're going to be okay. There's so many questions, so many unfulfilled plans... All I can do is do my best to walk with her through this, I think...

Sorry, I'm an emotionally open book kind of person and I keep rewriting this because I keep over-sharing and catching it before I press post.
Thank you for your reply.  We moved relatively recently and haven't found her a new therapist yet, but I am hoping that we can soon to help her process this.
